name: 3D Point Supervision Loss
definition: A training loss that minimizes the distance between learned 3D points (obtained by backprojecting rendered depth to the world frame) and ground-truth 3D points, successfully registering poses in sparse-view regimes.
summary: 3D Point Supervision Loss minimizes Euclidean distance between backprojected rendered depth and ground-truth points to enforce global geometric consistency, unlike direct depth regression which favors local geometry.
